flows.title: Inbound SIM Voice Call to AI Live
flows.description: A customer calls the phone SIM, Android connects to binary relay tunnel, Gemini Live answers in real time.

steps.note: Android SIM captures incoming call and requests voice session
Relay forwards 16kHz PCM audio over WSS binary tunnel
Gemini Live generates conversational Arabic Egyptian audio
CallLedgerService logs call and Gemini generates instant summary
Calls tab updates in real-time with waveform, audio player and lead link

flows.title: WHMCS Support Ticket with Zero-Knowledge PII Shield
flows.description: Customer submits a ticket on WHMCS, ontrack_bridge tokenizes sensitive PII, central multi-agent kernel diagnoses and reviews draft.

steps.note: ontrack_bridge tokenizes names, emails, IPs and domains locally
BridgeController authenticates HMAC signature and validates plan feature gating
MultiAgentOrchestrator consults Server Specialist and Reviewer
Emails & Tickets tab displays consultation timeline and 1-Click Approve

flows.title: Power Dialer Multi-Line Outbound Campaign
flows.description: Automated campaign dials customer list across connected Android SIMs with AMD and hold music.

steps.note: User starts Power Dialer with progressive/predictive pacing
CampaignDialerService claims next contact and checks DNC ledger
Android device executes call with Answering Machine Detection
